notes.title: Ice Cream update
notes.notes:
Diner 2 and Diner 4 now include very fancy, very Diner-style ice-cream. And yes, with little umbrellas, too!

Have fun,
--KOPI Team

notes.title: Cabin update
notes.notes:
Gingerbread and wurst madness: the Cabin levels now include three new recipes for you to enjoy! Embrace your inner Central European and start cooking and serving

* Pre-made, but definitely organic, gingerbread
* Hand-made, hand-glazed gingerbread
* Fried sausage on a slab of sourdough bread

Happy cooking and playing!

notes.title: Parklife update
notes.notes:
As the summer in the Northern hemisphere ends, we prepared a big park update for you.

* Park 1-4 now has infinite supply of hot water to make your cooking smoother.
* Park 1 has a new very simple recipe to get you started: donut.
* Park 2 now has a summer barbecue and a simple burger.
* Park 4 includes all park recipes.

Next update will include big improvements to gameplay fun with small challenges. 

Happy brewing
--The KOPI team
